about: Part d: the bare 'Bring me N' errands given a voice for the giver and the place.

entries.name: Dragonfly Wings
entries.before: Bring me two damaged dragonfly wings from the flies outside the walls of Freeport.
entries.after: House Slaerin does not buy from beggars. Bring me two damaged dragonfly wings from the flies outside the walls of Freeport.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Python Scales
entries.before: Go to the swamp and kill snakes. Bring me three ruined python scales.
entries.after: Snakes in swamp. Grobb needs scales. Go kill, bring me three ruined python scales.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Tarantula Leg Tips
entries.before: Bring me two tarantula leg tips. The hatchlings outside either gate carry them.
entries.after: My tinctures want tarantula. Bring me two leg tips from the hatchlings outside either gate of Highbourne.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: The Alchemist's Log
entries.before: Bring me a cracked beetle horn from the beetles round the gates, and 100 tunar.
entries.after: Bring me a cracked beetle horn from the beetles round the gates, and 100 tunar. Highbourne's scholars pay for what they use.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Strands of Rat Fur
entries.before: Bring me two strands of rat fur from the rats in the savannah.
entries.after: The savannah rats are thick as fleas. Bring me two strands of rat fur, and I will see it put to use.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: A Poison Sac
entries.before: Bring me a poison sac from a banded kingsnake outside town.
entries.after: A kingsnake's sac keeps a long while. Bring me one from a banded kingsnake outside town.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: The Staff of Necromancy
entries.before: Bring me a leather strap and a wooden shaft from Merchant Shudan, and a cracked rat claw.
entries.after: Highbourne's fleet wants arrows. Bring me a leather strap and a wooden shaft from Merchant Shudan, and a cracked rat claw.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: The Recruit's Shortsword
entries.before: Bring me a leather strip and iron ore from Merchant Shudan, and a beetle leg segment.
entries.after: A fine bowstring needs fine fittings. Bring me a leather strip and iron ore from Merchant Shudan, and a beetle leg segment.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: The Poison Sac
entries.before: Bring me a poison sac from the banded kingsnakes by the rocks out of the east gate.
entries.after: Bring me a poison sac from the banded kingsnakes by the rocks out of the east gate. Mind the fangs.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Mechanagic Fluid
entries.before: The Model II PEs of the Rogue Clockworks carry mechanagic fluid. Bring me some.
entries.after: The Model II PEs of the Rogue Clockworks carry mechanagic fluid, and Klick'Anon could use it. Bring me some!
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: A Stunned Mindwhipper
entries.before: Bring me a stunned mindwhipper, from the hive south along the hill past the west gate.
entries.after: A stunned mindwhipper is worth a month of study. Bring me one from the hive south along the hill past the west gate.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: The Rogue Clockworks
entries.before: There's a rumor of a new clockwork east of here, a model II PE. Bring me its metal frame.
entries.after: The Watch hears of a new clockwork east of here, a model II PE. Bring me its metal frame, and mind yourself.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: The Master Gear
entries.before: Bring me a master gear from a Model II PE clockwork, east of Klick'Anon.
entries.after: Ooh, a master gear! Bring me one from a Model II PE clockwork, east of Klick'Anon.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Proving Yourself
entries.before: Go outside and kill bats. Bring me two pieces of bat meat as proof.
entries.after: Bats are a nuisance, and the Dead take no interest in nuisances. Kill them outside, bring me two pieces of bat meat.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Rat Fur
entries.before: Bring me two strands of rat fur from the rats just outside town.
entries.after: Rivervale folk like a tidy burrow. Bring me two strands of rat fur from the rats just outside town.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Celedonicus's Sashes
entries.before: Bandits in the middle of Tak'Xiv wear sashes. Bring me four.
entries.after: Bandits in the middle of Tak'Xiv wear sashes. Qeynos would know them. Bring me four.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Nicton's Eyelash
entries.before: I need the eyelash of one of the eyes of the Elephant Graveyard. Bring me one.
entries.after: I need the eyelash of one of the eyes of the Elephant Graveyard. Bring me one, and watch its gaze.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Ice Giant Glyphs
entries.before: The tenacious giants carve glyphs into the ice. I study them. Bring me four.
entries.after: The tenacious giants carve glyphs into the ice, and I study them. Bring me four, if you can.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Small Chipped Rubies
entries.before: The Majorkahn giants carry little rubies, chipped, but pretty. Bring me four.
entries.after: The Majorkahn giants carry little rubies, chipped but pretty. A gypsy knows a bargain. Bring me four.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Giant Blue Pearl Rings
entries.before: The ice giants wear rings with blue pearls the size of eggs. Bring me four.
entries.after: The ice giants wear rings with blue pearls the size of eggs. Bring me four for my studies.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Pearl Rings of the Refugees
entries.before: Even the ice giants' refugees wear their pearl rings. Bring me four.
entries.after: Even the ice giants' refugees wear their pearl rings. A giant slayer counts them. Bring me four.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Flawed Black Diamonds
entries.before: Shadow wisps leave black diamonds when they fade, flawed but useful. Bring me four.
entries.after: Shadow wisps leave black diamonds when they fade, flawed but they suit my work. Bring me four.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Broken Leopard Claws
entries.before: Frost leopards break their claws on the ice. Bring me four broken claws.
entries.after: Frost leopards break their claws on the ice, and I gather what they leave. Bring me four broken claws.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Heavy Venom Sacs
entries.before: Freezefang spiders carry heavy venom sacs. Careful with them. Bring me four.
entries.after: Freezefang spiders carry heavy venom sacs, and I know their worth. Careful. Bring me four.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Savory Treant Roots
entries.before: Treant roots, savory and tender, for my soup. Bring me four.
entries.after: My soup wants treant roots, savory and tender. Bring me four from the treant defenders.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Ghoulish Preservatives
entries.before: Ghouls keep themselves with a preservative that keeps my meats too. Bring me four.
entries.after: Ghouls keep themselves with a preservative that keeps my meats too. Bring me four from the ghoul servants.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Purified Water Canteens
entries.before: The Taksehir miners carry the purest water there is. Bring me four canteens.
entries.after: The Taksehir miners carry the purest water there is, a cook's dream. Bring me four canteens.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Froglok Stomachs
entries.before: Froglok stomachs, stuffed, are a delicacy. Bring me four.
entries.after: Froglok stomachs, stuffed, are a delicacy. Bring me four from the froglok dar warriors.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Tasty Froglok Skins
entries.before: The froglok slayers have the tastiest skins. Crisp them in the fire... Bring me four.
entries.after: The froglok slayers have the tastiest skins, my secret. Crisp them in the fire... Bring me four.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Fiery Hot Peppers
entries.before: Peppers grow in animated lava, the hottest in the world. Bring me four.
entries.after: Peppers grow in animated lava, the hottest in the world. Bring me four, and do not singe yourself.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Bandit Herbs
entries.before: Bandits carry the best herbs; they steal them. Bring me four bundles.
entries.after: Bandits carry the best herbs; they steal them from better cooks. Bring me four bundles from the Taksehir bandits.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Evil Eye Corneas
entries.before: The children of Xrag have corneas that make a fine jelly. Bring me four.
entries.after: The children of Xrag have corneas that make a fine jelly, trust a cook. Bring me four.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Frost Giant Toes
entries.before: Frost giant toes, pickled, keep a winter. Bring me four.
entries.after: Frost giant toes, pickled, keep a winter. Bring me four from the tenacious frost giants.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Nixie Caps
entries.before: Nixies trample my crops. Bring me four of their caps, and I will know they learned.
entries.after: Nixies trample Murnf's crops. Bring me four of their caps, and I will know they learned.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: More Nixie Caps
entries.before: I collect nixie caps. Do not ask why. Bring me four.
entries.after: I collect nixie caps. Murnf folk keep their own counsel. Bring me four.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Dark Skull Rings
entries.before: Green goo swallows rings, and the dark skull rings it swallows are mine. Bring me four.
entries.after: Green goo swallows rings, and the dark skull rings it swallows are mine by right. Bring me four.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Mutant Ant Carapaces: Leafcutters
entries.before: The red ants south of the Oasis are mutating. Bring me four carapaces of the leafcutters.
entries.after: The red ants south of the Oasis are mutating, and the Gypsies want to know why. Bring me four carapaces of the leafcutters.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Mutant Ant Carapaces: Workers
entries.before: The red ant workers south of the Oasis are changing. Bring me four of their carapaces.
entries.after: The red ant workers south of the Oasis are changing, and I mean to learn how. Bring me four of their carapaces.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Mutant Ant Carapaces: Scouts
entries.before: Even the red ant scouts are changing. Bring me four of their carapaces.
entries.after: Even the red ant scouts are changing. The Oasis should hear of it. Bring me four of their carapaces.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Petrified Roses
entries.before: The desert gypsies carry petrified roses as charms. Bring me four.
entries.after: The desert gypsies carry petrified roses as charms. Forkwatch has use for them. Bring me four.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Platinum Gnoll Pendants
entries.before: The gnoll berserkers wear platinum pendants. Bring me four, and Qeynos will pay.
entries.after: The gnoll berserkers wear platinum pendants. Bring me four, and Qeynos will pay in coin.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Blood Paw Collars
entries.before: The Bloodpaw gnolls wear collars. Bring me four.
entries.after: The Bloodpaw gnolls wear collars, and Qeynos pays for proof. Bring me four.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Black Gnoll Rings
entries.before: The gnoll strongfangs wear black rings. Bring me four.
entries.after: The gnoll strongfangs wear black rings. Qeynos pays for proof. Bring me four.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Gnoll Ear Cuffs
entries.before: The gnoll stalkers wear ear cuffs. Bring me four.
entries.after: The gnoll stalkers wear ear cuffs. Qeynos pays for proof. Bring me four.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Matted Bear Hides
entries.before: Young bears' hides, matted or not, keep a house warm. Bring me four.
entries.after: Young bears' hides, matted or not, keep a house warm through winter. Bring me four.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Torn Snake Scales
entries.before: Moss snakes shed torn scales I can use. Bring me four.
entries.after: Moss snakes shed torn scales I can use. Bring me four, friend.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Pristine Raven Feathers
entries.before: Snow crows have pristine feathers, black as coal. Bring me four.
entries.after: Snow crows have pristine feathers, black as coal. A dwarf needs good fletching. Bring me four.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Pike Meat
entries.before: Pike meat for the pot. Bring me four pieces.
entries.after: Pike meat for the pot, Freeport's best. Bring me four pieces.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Ant Chitin
entries.before: Ant soldiers have the hardest chitin. Bring me four pieces.
entries.after: Ant soldiers have the hardest chitin, ideal for tinkering! Bring me four pieces.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Sunbeetle Carapaces
entries.before: Sunbeetles shine like gold in the sun. Bring me four of their carapaces.
entries.after: Sunbeetles shine like gold in the sun, a wonder near Qeynos. Bring me four of their carapaces.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Runes of Crethley Manor
entries.before: The dead of Crethley Manor, north of the lake, carry runes. Bring me a full stack: ten.
entries.after: The dead of Crethley Manor, north of the lake, carry runes I would study. Bring me a full stack: ten.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Ragh's Firepit: a Charm
entries.before: A bandit charm burns hotter than any blade. Bring me one.
entries.after: A bandit charm burns hotter than any blade. Bring me one. Ogre wants.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Weapons for the Liason
entries.before: Bring me the weapons of the Honor Guard, four at a time.
entries.after: The Collective wants what the Honor Guard carries. Bring me their weapons, four at a time.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: The Rallosian Lenses
entries.before: The Rallosian Arcanists carry lenses that see through our veils. Bring me two.
entries.after: The Rallosian Arcanists carry lenses that see through our veils. Bring me two, quietly.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: The Captains' Weapons
entries.before: The last test: the Honor Guard Captain and the Rallosian Captain. Bring me their weapons.
entries.after: The last test is hard: the Honor Guard Captain and the Rallosian Captain. Bring me their weapons.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Charred Bones
entries.before: The primordial tortoises carry charred bones. Bring me four.
entries.after: The primordial tortoises carry charred bones, good for a jeweler's work. Bring me four.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Unkempt Bracelets
entries.before: The unkempt tribesmen, druids and rangers carry unkempt bracelets. Bring me four.
entries.after: The unkempt tribesmen, druids and rangers carry unkempt bracelets. The council wants them. Bring me four.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Tiny Daggers
entries.before: The pixies carry tiny daggers. Bring me four.
entries.after: The pixies carry tiny daggers. Bring me four, if you can catch them.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Drachnid Leg Tips
entries.before: The drachnids of the salt mines carry drachnid leg tips. Bring me four.
entries.after: The drachnids of the salt mines carry drachnid leg tips, useful for my tinkering. Bring me four.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Chipped Badger Claws
entries.before: The giant badgers carry chipped badger claws. Bring me four.
entries.after: The giant badgers carry chipped badger claws, handy for my needs. Bring me four.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Preserved Zombie Eyes
entries.before: The restless zombies carry preserved zombie eyes. Bring me four.
entries.after: The restless zombies carry preserved zombie eyes. Bring me four, and forgive my trade.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Cinder Cat Wings
entries.before: The cinder cats carry wings. Bring me five.
entries.after: The cinder cats carry wings, and the flame burns them clean. Bring me five.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Cinder Cat Fangs
entries.before: The cinder cats carry fangs. Bring me five.
entries.after: The cinder cats carry fangs, and fire hardens them. Bring me five.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Basilisk Claws
entries.before: The fire basilisks near my fire have claws that crack into a fine broth. Bring me four.
entries.after: The fire basilisks near my fire have claws that crack into a fine broth, so go hunt. Bring me four.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Flavored Mushrooms
entries.before: The fungal folk of Guk grow the most flavorful mushrooms. Bring me four.
entries.after: The fungal folk of Guk grow the most flavorful mushrooms, damp and rich. Bring me four.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Preserved Ghast Eyes
entries.before: The ghasts of Collonridge Cemetery carry preserved ghast eyes. Bring me four.
entries.after: The ghasts of Collonridge Cemetery carry preserved ghast eyes. Bring me four, and a steady stomach.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Dark Silver Rings
entries.before: The Deathfist legionnaires wear dark silver rings. Bring me four.
entries.after: The Deathfist legionnaires wear dark silver rings. Fist of Marr counts them. Bring me four.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Deathfist Insignia Rings
entries.before: The Deathfist champions and clerics of the citadel wear insignia rings. Bring me four.
entries.after: The Deathfist champions and clerics of the citadel wear insignia rings. Fist of Marr wants them. Bring me four.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Platinum Insignias
entries.before: The Deathfist reavers and slayers carry platinum insignias. Bring me four.
entries.after: The Deathfist reavers and slayers carry platinum insignias. Fist of Marr wants them. Bring me four.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Deathfist Seals
entries.before: The Deathfist myrmidons west of the tea garden carry the citadel's seals. Bring me four.
entries.after: The Deathfist myrmidons west of the tea garden carry the citadel's seals. Fist of Marr wants them. Bring me four.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Rat Whiskers
entries.before: The ratmen of Cape Dreg have whiskers stiff enough for my brushes. Bring me four.
entries.after: The ratmen of Cape Dreg have whiskers stiff enough for my brushes, a handyman's boon. Bring me four.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: The Shalebone Wolf
entries.before: Bring me the pelt of the shalebone wolf that wanders the shores to the north.
entries.after: The shores to the north are wild. Bring me the pelt of the shalebone wolf that wanders there, for Fayspires.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Yellowjack Water
entries.before: Bring me a forger wolf fang, from the narrow passage into Misty Thicket.
entries.after: Bring me a forger wolf fang, from the narrow passage into Misty Thicket. The elves of Fayspires need it.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Sparkfly Wings
entries.before: Bring me two sparkfly wings.
entries.after: Bring me two sparkfly wings. The light is in them.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Bellia's Weapon
entries.before: Bring me a strip of leather and iron ore from Merchant Grener, and two cracked rat claws.
entries.after: Bring me a strip of leather and iron ore from Merchant Grener, and two cracked rat claws, for my loom.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Johandar's Sword
entries.before: Bring me a strip of leather and iron ore from Merchant Grener, and two spider eyes.
entries.after: Bring me a strip of leather and iron ore from Merchant Grener, and two spider eyes, for my craft.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade

entries.name: Rat Furs
entries.before: Bring me two rat furs from the rats out of town.
entries.after: The rats out of town gnaw at my studies. Bring me two rat furs.
entries.why: voice from giver, city and trade
